CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 5

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 100
   C. 10
   D. 50

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 30

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 55
   C. 16
   D. 32

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 28
   C. 22
   D. 33

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

17. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 45
   C. 36
   D. 18

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 36

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 105

22. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 13

23. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 4

24. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
